description: List the cities GeoLocale covers, filtered by part of a city name and/or a country. Returns each city's id, its number of neighborhoods, how many have counts, the date of its map data and the address of its page.

country.description: Part of a country name in English, for example "portugal".

limit.description: How many cities to return. Default 25.

query.description: Part of a city name, for example "lisbon".

name: find_cities
title: Find cities on GeoLocale
